provenance.sourceType: CommunityDragon extracted game-client data; version pinned by URL, unofficial mirror, not a Riot-published public roster API
provenance.extraction: Fetched the 14.23 en_us CDragon payload in memory; selected sets["13"], plus only the item and augment apiName references listed by setData[number=13]. Natural champions are apiName TFT13_* with cost 1..5 and at least one native trait. Natural traits are TFT13_* excluding TFT13_Teamup_*; Team-Up traits are preserved separately as conditional mechanic candidates.
provenance.excluded: No other setData rows, other sets, or unreferenced top-level items included. Excluded neutral PvE encounters, cost-8 loot/anvil/chest entries, and cost-11 summoned/encounter entities from the natural champion pool.

schema.champions: Complete CDragon Set13 champion rows, including name/apiName/cost/traits/stats/ability and client asset identifiers.
schema.traits: 26 naturally assigned traits, complete CDragon rows with desc and effects[{minUnits,maxUnits,style,variables}], plus joined natural membership and fee distribution.
schema.conditionalTeamUpTraits: 7 separately preserved TFT13_Teamup_* rows; they are not in natural champion trait memberships and require conditional Team-Up activation.
schema.equipmentCandidates: Exactly setData[number=13].items references resolved to top-level item rows; includes carried-forward items when listed as Set 13 members, excludes items absent from this Set 13 list.
schema.augmentCandidates: Exactly setData[number=13].augments references resolved to top-level item rows; includes returning augments when listed as Set 13 members, excludes all unreferenced augments.
